turn.subject: plan
turn.user_message: Yes — put it into a plan

text: Start with a two-week trial on one ward. It needs no new staff and no new system, and it tells us how much of the 5 hours really comes back.
Hire the Discharge Manager now, not after the trial. Your own numbers are already past both lines, so this isn’t a maybe-someday. They can run the trial.
chat.invite: Would you like me to plan the two-week trial in detail, or first walk you through what the full software does each day?
chat.note: Prove it on one ward, then grow it.
prompts: Why hire the manager before the trial ends?
What will the trial cost us?

blocks.title: Try it on one ward first

blocks.label: In order

steps.title: Start the trial on one ward
Link the software, ward by ward

blocks.caption: The trial runs the new order of steps by hand, so it needs no new system. It turns the biggest guess into a measured fact.

items.title: Hire the Discharge Manager now
items.text: Your numbers already call for one. They run the trial.
more_points: 88% of your beds are in use. The line is 80%.
40 to 45 patients go home each day. The line is 40.
Both are your own numbers, and each is enough on its own.

items.title: What the trial needs from you
items.text: One ward, the doctors’ agreement, and someone to note the times.
more_points: One ward with a usual mix of patients paying themselves and insured patients.
Doctors on that ward agree to decide on the 7 PM round, as they already do.
One person to write down the times for each patient going home.
Your IT team to share the records the trial needs.
